attchmntText: Rmc Switchgears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 24, 2026, titled "Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015   Press Release titled  RMC Switchgears receives Letter of Intent for an estimated ₹521.84 crore turnkey distribution-infrastructure package in Maharashtra  ".
voiceSummary: RMC Switchgears Limited received a Letter of Intent for an estimated 521.84 crore turnkey distribution infrastructure package in Maharashtra. The project is funded by the Asian Development Bank. It covers the supply, testing, transportation, construction, erection, testing, and commissioning of new substations. The scope includes augmentation of existing substations, additional power transformers, high tension lines, and allied works. The company stated the engagement builds on its experience in Jalna and Satara. The release notes that actual outcomes may differ due to contractual terms, approvals, and execution risks. This disclosure is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. The announcement was dated 24 November 2026.

attchmntText: Rmc Switchgears Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: RMC Switchgears Limited received Letters of Award totaling 521,83,68,000 rupees for development of distribution infrastructure and systems strengthening works. The contract covers supply, testing, transport, construction, erection, and commissioning of new substations, augmentation of substations, additional power transformers, HT lines, and allied works. The award was granted by a domestic entity. The nature of the order includes civil work and supply and installation of plant and equipment. The execution period is 24 months. The company confirms that no promoter or group company has an interest in the entity awarding the order. The contract does not fall within related party transactions. This receipt strengthens the company's order book and is expected to contribute positively to revenue and growth prospects.
